sources.title: Meeting notes in, action list out

sections.heading: Meeting notes in. Action list out.
sections.text:
Paste the notes from any meeting and Checkmint pulls out every to-do, with an owner and a due date, in about three seconds.

Tidy my notes

sections.heading: Paste your notes
sections.text:
Drop in the notes exactly as you took them. Half sentences are fine.

Priya sends the Q3 deck by Friday Sam fixes the login bug before Tuesday everyone review pricing page??

2

sections.heading: Press Tidy it
sections.text:
One button. Checkmint reads who said they would do what, and by when.

3

sections.heading: Get the list
sections.text:
Every action on its own line, with an owner and a due date, ready to copy.

3 actions · 3 owners

| Action | Owner | Due |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Send the Q3 deck | Priya | Fri |
| Fix the login bug | Sam | Tue |
| Review the pricing page | Everyone | Thu |

sections.heading: Where do my notes go?
sections.text: Nowhere. Checkmint tidies your notes in the browser tab you pasted them into.
